purpose: Draft production sprite sheet for the Leaf Bridge, Wild Leaf, chapter memento and root obstacle; integration and rendered acceptance are pending.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent game UI sprite sheet for a child-friendly WeightPlay Block Animals word-path puzzle. Create exactly four distinct original object icons, each centered in its own evenly spaced square quadrant in a clean 2 by 2 grid with broad transparent gutters, no borders, no overlapping objects: upper left a small movable bridge built from two rectangular wooden planks and a bright green leaf; upper right a single luminous emerald leaf shaped like a small tile with a clear cutout center for an external UI glyph; lower left a square wooden trail marker with a faceted gold star and tiny sprout (chapter memento); lower right a square obstacle of interlocking brown roots and rock. All objects are made of visible cubes and rectangular prisms with stepped silhouettes, polished hand-painted game rendering, clear silhouettes at 40 pixels, warm woodland palette, soft dimensional lighting. Transparent background, no characters, no text, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no watermark. Preserve separation between quadrants so each can be used as an individual icon.
